title: 第94章 老祖宗现身
content_zh:
第94章 老祖宗现身-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

运气还算不错，可能是大家大多已经开始上班，电影院里的人不算多，余票还挺充足。

两人选了半小时后开场的场次，特意挑了最后排的座位，旁边要是没人，还能把念念放出来，让她也跟着蹭一场电影看，小丫头肯定开心。

爆米花是看电影的灵魂，自然必不可少，吴姜买了一桶超大份的爆米花和两杯可乐，没等多久，就开始检票入场了。

整场电影下来，影院里笑声不断，吴姜和李月芽笑得那是一个前仰后合，就连念念，也是跟着捧腹大笑。

“芽芽，接下来怎么安排，要不要跟哥到酒店耍耍？”

出了电影院，吴姜贱笑着对李月芽说道。

得到的，是李月芽的一脚。

“滚犊子，送我回家！”

吴姜哈哈笑了一声，本来就是跟她开个玩笑，自然不会使坏，开车将李月芽送回了家，看着她安全上楼，才转身驱车返回自己的住处。

回到家后，吴姜在兑换中心，兑换了一粒疗伤丹药，经过一夜修养，，他身上的伤势已经恢复大半了，晚上再调息一次，就没有大碍了。

起来洗漱之后，开车去了丧葬一条街，到了老刘的店里。

老刘一见是吴姜进来，笑着调侃：“真稀奇，居然大白天的过来了！”

吴姜赏给他一个大大的白眼，没好气地说道：“不就那么两次嘛，你至于记得这么清楚吗？行了，今天是来照顾你生意的，对待上帝，能不能热情点？”

“你给我滚犊子吧！就你还上帝呢，你配吗？”老刘不吃他那一套，嘴上吐槽着，手脚却已经麻利地准备起来，“说吧，这次又要什么？”

两人又互损了几句，吴姜才将自己需要的东西，让老刘给他备齐了。

今天他准备去绿城的城隍庙上香，这也是临来的时候，老爷子叮嘱的。

绿城的城隍庙，比起苍名县的，大的太多了，吴姜随意的逛了一圈，才去了主殿。

I was pretty lucky, maybe because most of the people had already started to go to work, there were not many people in the cinema, and there were quite enough tickets left.

The two of them chose a show that would open in half an hour, and specifically chose seats in the last row. If there was no one next to them, they could let Nian Nian out and let her watch a movie too. The little girl would definitely be happy.

Popcorn is the soul of watching movies, so it is indispensable. Wu Jiang bought an extra-large bucket of popcorn and two cups of Coke, and before long, he started checking in for tickets.

Throughout the movie, there was constant laughter in the theater. Wu Jiang and Li Yueya were laughing so hard that even Nian Nian was laughing along with them.

"Yaya, what are your plans next? Do you want to go to the hotel with me to have fun?"

After leaving the cinema, Wu Jiangjian smiled and said to Li Yueya.

What he got was a kick from Li Yueya.

"Get out of here, take me home!"

Wu Jiang laughed loudly. He was just joking with her, so he would not cause any harm. He drove Li Yueya back home, watched her go upstairs safely, and then turned around and drove back to his residence.

After returning home, Wu Jiang exchanged a healing elixir at the exchange center. After a night of cultivation, most of his injuries had recovered. After adjusting his breathing at night, he was fine.

After getting up and washing up, I drove to Funeral Street and arrived at Lao Liu's shop.

When Old Liu saw Wu Jiang coming in, he laughed and joked: "It's strange that he came here in broad daylight!"

Wu Jiang gave him a big eye roll and said angrily: "It's just those two times. Do you remember it so clearly? Okay, today I'm here to take care of your business. Can you be more enthusiastic towards God?"

"Get out of here! You're the only one who wants to repay God. Do you deserve it?" Lao Liu refused to follow his example and complained, but his hands and feet were already ready, "Tell me, what do you want this time?"

The two exchanged some insults before Wu Jiang asked Lao Liu to prepare everything he needed.

Today he was going to go to the City God's Temple in Green City to offer incense, which was what the old man had told him when he arrived.

The Chenghuang Temple in Green City was much bigger than the one in Cangming County. Wu Jiang walked around casually before going to the main hall.
